content.value: Two smooth spheres A and B with velocities of $V _ { \mathsf { A } 1 } = 1 0$ fps and $v _ { \mathsf { B } 1 } = 1 2$ fps, collide when these velocities are directed at angles of $3 0 ^ { \circ }$ and $60 ^ { \circ }$ with the line centers as shown. The spheres are equal size but A weighs ${ w _ { A } } = 6$ Ib and B weighs $\mathtt { w _ { \mathsf { B } } } = 3$ Ib. The co-efficient of restitution is 0.7. (i) What are the absolute velocities of these spheres immediate after impact? (ii) what is the loss of kinetic energy?
